whatThisIs: the production storeResults over N real corpus markdown files, read back with SQL: how many stored edges carry a resolved target_symbol_id, and how many targets extractLeaf rewrites before the name match
whatThisIsNot: a whole-project number. One temp project root, so the store's unique-name stage (_res_name.cnt, parallel-indexer.ts:4008-4020) sees project-wide uniqueness over these N files only. Resolution here is an UPPER bound: a name unique in this project can be published many times in the corpus.

sample.order: repo ascending then rel ascending — the same ordering as validation/m14/fixtures/markdown/whole-corpus-census.ts, so this is a PREFIX of that population, not an independent draw
sample.admissionTest: detectLanguageFromPath(abs, text) === 'markdown', size <= 512 KB, git ls-files

exactReconciliation.grainWarning: an earlier per-EDGE version of this block reported 1,810 rows 'lost to the source fold'. That was the probe's own artifact: :3420-3423 and :3531-3541 legitimately re-anchor a source, so the row exists. Only n-m at a key is a loss, and only that is claimed here.

facts.what: the loss is resolved to a mechanism rather than left as a residual: at the (type, target, line) grain the deficit minus the surplus equals emitted minus stored, and no stored row exists at a key the analyzer did not emit
the store writes no row at a (type, target, line) the analyzer did not emit, so the coarse tally's 20-row surplus is a grain artifact and not rows the store invented
the rewritten/unbound split sums to the rewritten total
the duplicate VALUES clause was present and was repaired in memory
